name: WiFi Deauther
one_line: ESP8266-based standalone device that sends 802.11 deauthentication frames to disconnect clients from a WiFi network, plus beacon and probe-request spamming, controlled via a web UI. Converted from GBP 37 at ~1.354 USD/GBP.
why_notable: Purpose-built, cased deauth/beacon-spam tool distinct from the DSTIKE Deauther Watch and generic Deauth Detector already tracked.

name: WiFi ESP32 Marauder for Flipper Zero
one_line: ESP32-S3 WiFi/Bluetooth analysis add-on for Flipper Zero running Marauder firmware for frame capture, device enumeration, and frame transmission.
why_notable: Third-party ESP32-S3 Marauder devboard for Flipper Zero; a different chip generation from the official ESP32-S2 Wi-Fi Dev Board already tracked.

name: TP-LINK TL-MR3020 Mini Wireless Router
one_line: Small travel router (802.11n, 150Mbps) explicitly marketed by the listing as OpenWRT and MiniPwner compatible.
why_notable: It's a retail travel router (normally out of scope), but this SKU is sold specifically for reflashing into a MiniPwner-style covert network drop-box.

name: Flipper Add-On: Marauder_Spoof
one_line: Flipper Zero GPIO add-on board running ESP32 Marauder firmware with added WiFi/BLE spoofing hardware.
why_notable: Flipper-form-factor ESP32 Marauder board, distinct SKU from Electronic Cats' plain Marauder add-on.

name: ESP32 Network Toolbox
one_line: ESP32 board with an Android companion app: Wi-Fi scanning, promiscuous packet sniffing, deauth frames, evil-twin captive portal, network mapping and BLE scanning, exporting PCAP/CSV/JSON.
why_notable: Full Wi-Fi pentest toolbox with a phone app. Listing shows out of stock since Aug 2023 - supply needs checking.

name: ALFA AWUS036ACM
one_line: USB 3.0 802.11ac Wi-Fi adapter (MediaTek MT7612U), dual-band 2.4/5GHz, 2x detachable dipole antennas on RP-SMA; marketed here for monitor-mode/packet-injection use in Linux/Kali workflows. Sold by JCMK as an ALFA reseller, not a JCMK design.
why_notable: Same category of item as the AWUS036AXM above - a widely used monitor-mode/injection-capable Wi-Fi adapter, but a general-purpose network adapter rather than a purpose-built gadget.
mcu: n/a (MediaTek MT7612U chipset, no general-purpose MCU)

name: ESP32-MDK for Portapack H4M
one_line: ESP32 add-on module that adds WiFi application support to a HackRF/PortaPack H4M setup.
why_notable: Adds a WiFi radio to the PortaPack/HackRF platform, a capability not present in the existing HackRF entries.

name: AC1200 USB-C WiFi Card (supports monitor mode)
one_line: MT7921AUN-based WiFi 6E/BT 5.2 M.2 card with monitor-mode support, sized to install inside the uConsole AIO board.
why_notable: Monitor-mode-capable WiFi 6E radio card sold specifically for pentest/wardriving builds, though it only fits inside the uConsole enclosure rather than standing alone.

name: Evil-M5Project
one_line: Wi-Fi pentest / evil-portal firmware with on-device UI for M5Stack Core2 (also AtomS3 and Fire): scanning, monitoring, karma and captive-portal attacks.
why_notable: 2623 stars, last commit 2026-09-06. The major M5Stack Wi-Fi firmware outside the Marauder/Ghost/Bruce family.

name: Dual Band WiFi MT7921AU
one_line: USB WiFi 6 adapter (MT7921AU chipset, mt76 driver) that the listing states supports monitor mode and packet injection on 802.11 a/g/n/ac.
why_notable: A monitor-mode/injection-capable WiFi adapter, a device class not otherwise present in the DB.

name: Flipper Add-On: Marauder
one_line: Flipper Zero GPIO add-on board running ESP32 Marauder firmware for WiFi/BLE scanning, deauth, and packet capture.
why_notable: Gives the Flipper Zero ESP32 Marauder WiFi/BLE audit capability via a dedicated add-on board.

name: wardriver3000
one_line: Portable ESP32 + GPS + OLED + microSD wardriving device on a custom PCB with Wigle.net upload.

name: Wifi deauther PLUG PLAY ESP8266 v2.0
one_line: Pre-flashed NodeMCU with a web deauther UI at 192.168.4.1 supporting SSID spoofing, probe-request spam and deauthentication, powered over micro-USB.

name: ESP32 Wardriver Pro
one_line: Passive-only ESP32 + GPS + OLED + SD wardriving logger writing WiGLE CSVs; explicitly does not deauth, join networks or inject.
why_notable: 40 stars, last commit 2026-05-18. Deliberately legal-safe design philosophy, a contrast to the active-attack tools.

name: Flipper Zero Dev Board Pro GPS Expansion
one_line: Add-on PCB + replacement faceplate that adds GPS over UART to JCMK's Flipper Zero Dev Board Pro, unlocking Marauder's wardriving features on that board.
why_notable: Small capability-adding accessory (GPS for wardriving) rather than a standalone device - flagged borderline since it only exists to upgrade the Dev Board Pro entry above, but it is a real capability add, not a generic cable.
mcu: n/a (GPS breakout + faceplate, no MCU of its own)
has_gps: yes, adds GPS via UART (ceramic antenna included)

name: WiFi Dev Board GPS Expansion
one_line: Solder-on adapter PCB that adds a microSD slot and GPS to the official (non-JCMK) Flipper Zero WiFi Dev Board, plus UART activity LEDs, enabling Marauder's PCAP/wardriving storage on that board.
why_notable: Same borderline reasoning as the Dev Board Pro GPS Expansion: a capability-adding accessory for a board already in the DB (the official Flipper Zero Wi-Fi Dev Board), not a standalone device.
mcu: n/a (SD/GPS breakout, no MCU of its own)
has_ext_antenna: via GPS module (not detailed as SMA)
